text:
kevin: hey all, new hire question: I'm on Windows 11 using WSL2 (Ubuntu). installed asdf in WSL and set up nodejs, python. but when I open the repo in VS Code using Remote-WSL, my terminal in VS Code shows asdf shims fine, but the debug run in VS Code uses the Windows-side node (and fails). any tips?

marta: welcome kevin! VS Code can run debug tasks on either side depending on launch.json and which runtime it detects. make sure your VS Code window is connected to WSL (bottom-left should say "WSL: Ubuntu") and that your workspace is opened from the WSL filesystem (/home/...).

kevin: it does say "WSL: Ubuntu" and my project path is /home/kevin/repo. yet the debug overlay shows path like C:\\Users\\kevin\\AppData... which is the Windows node.

devops: likely cause is the debug extension using a windows-hosted helper or a config in launch.json with an absolute runtimeExecutable. check launch.json; if "runtimeExecutable" is set to something like "C:\\Program Files\\nodejs\\node.exe" remove it or set it to "node" so it resolves inside WSL. Also ensure you installed the VS Code Remote - WSL extension and restarted the WSL window after changing PATH.

marta: another gotcha: if you use the Windows-side VS Code (not the WSL one) to open a folder over a network mount, it won't honor WSL fs shims. Always press the green >< icon -> "Remote-WSL: New Window" then open the folder from the WSL tree.

kevin: aha launch.json had an old absolute path leftover from a previous setup. changed "runtimeExecutable" to "node" and restarted the WSL window. debug now picks up ~/.asdf/shims/node and breakpoints work. thanks!

devops: extra tip: for tasks that spawn from the host (like preLaunchTask) ensure the task's "command" is available in WSL. If you have formatters installed via pipx in WSL, put them in ~/.local/bin and add that to PATH in ~/.profile or ~/.zprofile so VS Code's integrated terminal and tasks see them.

kevin: noted. I also had to move my asdf init lines into ~/.profile so non-login shells inherit the PATH for some VS Code integrations.

onboard-bot: Welcome @kevin! Great debug summary. If you'd like, add a short note to the onboarding doc about "VS Code Remote-WSL: ensure runtimeExecutable not hardcoded and asdf init in shell profile" and open a PR.
